hypothesis: A higher-capacity streaming ASR improves grounded tool-argument accuracy on hard spoken identifiers without materially regressing foreground responsiveness.

motivation.classification: post-hoc mechanism observation; not an evaluation subset or success criterion
motivation.observation: The frozen 0.6B control run remained responsive but repeatedly mistranscribed an alphanumeric user identifier, after which the slow model issued structurally valid calls with incorrect arguments.
motivation.prohibited_adaptation: No task text, expected tool call, identifier pattern, or benchmark label may be supplied to ASR or used for routing.

shared_runtime.backend: official qwen_asr streaming demo backed by vLLM
shared_runtime.hardware: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 97887 MiB

controlled_variables: all 278 base tasks in airline, retail, and telecom
seed 300 and one trial per task
Fish S2-Pro caller and agent voices
50 ms internal opportunities and 200 ms benchmark ticks
canonical tool authority and exact result resumption
single-GPU co-location and max concurrency one
primary_outcomes: tau pass^1 overall and by domain
exact tool name and argument correctness
ASR advance latency and real-time factor
acceptance_rule: Accept 1.7B only on a complete paired cell when grounded task/tool correctness improves without a meaningful regression in response/yield latency or interaction selectivity. The motivating task alone cannot pass this gate.
